result.title: Towards Robust Vision-Language Reasoning: A Multi-Stage Optimization Pipeline with Masked Diffusion Model
result.summary: Discrete diffusion generation is emerging as a competitive alternative to autoregressive generation by denoising the entire token sequence through iterative refinement. Its global planning and progressive correction capabilities are particularly well suited to autonomous driving. However, transferring this generation paradigm from general-purpose settings to driving introduces substantial domain gaps in both training and inference. To unlock its potential, we propose a multi-stage optimization pipeline for standard vision-language model architectures, without auxiliary action experts or specialized mixture-of-experts Transformer, spanning post-training and inference. During supervised fine-tuning, we optimize the representation of planning inputs to suppress hallucinations in task responses. During reinforcement learning, we introduce metric-guided diversity filtering to identify stronger learning starting points and improve policy exploration. At inference time, we propose Dynamic Autonomous Driving Decoding (DAD), which adaptively adjusts decoding modes according to scene complexity. Based on this pipeline, we develop Masked Diffusion Drive (MD-Drive), improving its performance by 29.7\% over the unoptimized model. Experiments on the NAVSIM closed loop benchmark and the nuScenes and DriveCoT open loop datasets show that MD-Drive outperforms autoregressive VLM baselines with the same architecture, while achieving a more favorable balance between performance and computational cost than systems with different architectures through discrete diffusion training and inference.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向自动驾驶视觉语言模型，提出覆盖监督微调、强化学习与推理的多阶段优化流程，并在推理期用按场景复杂度自适应切换解码模式的动态解码策略，构建离散扩散式的 MD-Drive，在 NAVSIM 闭环与 nuScenes、DriveCoT 上对比同架构自回归基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 masked diffusion 全序列迭代精化与按复杂度调整解码模式的思路，可为 LVR 中并行/扩散式推理状态生成及动态计算与停止决策提供线索，但需核查其生成内容是规划 token 而非显式 latent 推理状态，迁移属可能而非已验证。
